msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia centro-optico-emperatriz-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of round dark sunglasses on a sunny white surface with a palm shadow from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia centro-optico-emperatriz-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of round black sunglasses with dark lenses, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia centro-optico-emperatriz-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of transparent light blue rectangular eyeglasses, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia centro-optico-emperatriz-14.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of cat-eye sunglasses in burgundy and black on a straw hat, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia centro-optico-emperatriz-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a box of monthly contact lenses, no brand name from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.

IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia centro-optico-emperatriz-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle photo: a smiling young woman wearing tortoiseshell eyeglasses in a modern optician shop, like in the reference, soft natural light, editorial, warm and inviting, shallow depth of field. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
